summary: Markline captures the page you are on so you can mark it up. Captures stay on your computer, and Markline uploads nothing.
reads: The current tab, after you click the icon or press a capture shortcut.
Where emails and phone numbers sit on the page, so they can be blurred. Only their position is used.
An image you drop, paste or choose in the editor.
stores: Settings on your computer: auto blur, blur style, export defaults and language.
A capture is passed to the editor tab through browser storage and deleted within seconds. Closing the editor tab removes the capture.
never: Upload captures or create share links
Send pages, images or notes to any server
Keep a history of what you captured

perms.name: activeTab
perms.why: Capture and read the current tab after you click or press a shortcut.

perms.name: scripting
perms.why: Find emails and phone numbers to blur, show the area and element picker, and scroll for a full page capture.

perms.name: storage
perms.why: Save your settings on your computer.

notes: Page details (address, browser, window size, time) are added to an export only if that switch is on.
The “Made with Markline” line on images is optional and can be turned off in settings.
